title: Project Overview
description:
# Project Overview

## Purpose

Medical Passport is an international digital medical ecosystem that helps people safely travel with chronic diseases, prescription medicines and medical history.

The platform allows patients, doctors, pharmacies and emergency services to securely exchange medical information anywhere in the world.

---

## Mission

Create one international medical passport accepted worldwide.

---

## Vision

Become the global standard for secure medical information exchange.

---

## Target Users

- Patients
- Travelers
- Doctors
- Pharmacies
- Hospitals
- Insurance Companies
- Emergency Services
- Family Members

---

## Core Modules

- Medical Profile
- Medicines
- Diagnoses
- Allergies
- Vaccinations
- Documents
- QR Passport
- SOS
- AI Assistant
- Medical Translator
- Travel Mode
- Telemedicine
- Notifications
- Family Profiles
- Emergency Contacts

---

## Platforms

- Android
- iPhone
- iPad
- Web

---

## Languages

International multilingual support.

---

## Status

Documentation Phase
